title: Knowledge Audit State
description: UC7KS Knowledge Pipeline audit state. Tracks knowledge acquisition activity across all agents. KC-02 (2026-06-21): activated as bounded aggregate audit rollup with non-fatal writers.

enabled.description: Whether knowledge pipeline auditing is enabled. Default: true.

last_cache_check.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last cache check operation.

last_knowledge_acquisition.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last external knowledge acquisition by @Knowledge-Curator.

aggregate.description: Bounded aggregate audit counters. Rollup of all knowledge pipeline activity since last reset.

total_cache_checks.description: Total number of cache check operations (knowledge_cache_search calls).

total_cache_hits.description: Total number of cache lookups that found matching entries.

total_cache_misses.description: Total number of cache lookups that found zero matching entries.

total_attestations.description: Total number of successful knowledge_cache_attest calls.

total_attestation_failures.description: Total number of failed knowledge_cache_attest calls (any step failure).

total_curator_dispatches.description: Total number of @Knowledge-Curator dispatches for knowledge acquisition.

total_external_fetches.description: Total number of external document fetches by @Knowledge-Curator.

reverse_orphan_count.description: Current count of orphaned cache files (on disk but not in index.json).

last_cleanup_removed_session_entries.description: Number of stale session entries removed during last cleanup pass.

recent_events.description: Bounded ring buffer of recent knowledge pipeline events (max 100 items, oldest evicted).

event.description: Event type (e.g., KC-CHECK, KC-HIT, KC-MISS, KC-ATTEST, KC-ATTEST-FAIL, KC-DISPATCH, KC-FETCH, KC-ORPHAN, KC-CLEANUP).

task_id.description: DAG task ID associated with the event.

domain.description: Knowledge domain associated with the event.

current_session.description: Per-session knowledge audit state (legacy — retained for backward compatibility).
